svg.title: Appendix A4: references
svg.desc: The main public sources consulted for this project: Debezium, Netflix DBLog, eBPF, Apache Flink CDC and the Flink Kubernetes Operator, and Strimzi. A separate column lists the author's own references: the Lactifluus repository and the author's Medium article.
